assets.name: campaign-01-east-asian-minimal
assets.detail: Model: East Asian woman around 29, distinctive angular face, shoulder-length dark hair swept loosely back with a few natural flyaways, minimal makeup, quietly confident gaze slightly past camera, mouth relaxed and unsmiling. Wardrobe: premium ivory heavyweight cotton boxy crewneck T-shirt with sculptural short sleeves and beautiful drape, charcoal tailored wide-leg trousers. Pose: body slightly turned, weight shifted onto one hip, one thumb hooked casually at trouser pocket below shirt hem, other arm relaxed with natural elbow bend, shoulders subtly asymmetric. A refined minimalist designer campaign, understated cool.
assets.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Produce ONE high-end contemporary fashion brand campaign photograph of a fictional adult model wearing a T-shirt, isolated as a clean genuinely transparent PNG with alpha. This must feel like a real photographer captured a charismatic working fashion model, NOT a mannequin, generic stock-photo person, CGI or AI beauty portrait. Real visible pores, subtle skin tone variation, tiny imperfections, believable eyes, natural asymmetry, individual personality. Premium editorial styling, tactile fabric, intentional directional large softbox key and gentle fill, shape and dimensionality without dramatic colored light. True transparent background all around subject, no backdrop, no aura, no halo, no ground shadow, no checkerboard baked into image. Portrait 2:3, head to upper thighs, leave breathing room above hair and beside elbows, never crop head or hands. Single person. The T-shirt is the hero: visible collar, sleeves, silhouette and hem, realistic weight, seams and natural folds. Relaxed expressive fashion pose, no passport pose, no stiff symmetric arms, no hands covering chest. No logos, no lettering, no watermark, no props. Pose: natural walking pause, torso in gentle three-quarter angle, head turning back toward camera, one arm slightly swinging clear of shirt, other hand casually at pocket below hem; candid motion and easy confidence. Elevated streetwear label campaign, stylish and authentic.
